title: Relationship
description: A directed edge between two entities representing a dependency, containment, inheritance, or other structural relationship discovered during analysis.

sourceEntityId.description: Identifier of the entity from which this relationship originates.

targetEntityId.description: Identifier of the entity that this relationship points to. Null when the target cannot be resolved (external or unresolved dependency).

kind.description: The semantic kind of relationship between the two entities.

sourceFilePath.description: Repository-relative path of the file containing the source entity. Denormalized for efficient lookup without entity join.

targetFilePath.description: Repository-relative path of the file containing the target entity. Null when unresolved.

sourceRange.description: Source location of the statement or expression that creates this relationship.

targetRange.description: Source location of the target symbol definition. Null when the target is unresolved or external.

resolutionKind.description: How the target was resolved: 'resolved' = fully matched to a known entity, 'proxy' = matched to a file/module but not a specific entity, 'unresolved' = target could not be found.

targetClassification.description: Semantic classification of the target entity, used for Dependency Inversion Principle analysis.

targetIsAbstraction.description: True if the target entity is considered an abstraction (interface, abstract class, type alias). Used for DIP compliance scoring.

consumedMembers.description: Names of the target's public API members that the source entity actually uses. Null when consumption cannot be determined. Used for Interface Segregation Principle analysis.

targetTotalMembers.description: Total number of public API members on the target entity. Null when the count cannot be determined. Used alongside consumedMembers for ISP ratio calculation.

crossModule.description: True if this relationship crosses a module boundary.

crossPackage.description: True if this relationship crosses a package boundary.

thirdParty.description: True if the target entity belongs to a third-party dependency (not part of the analysed codebase).

typeOnly.description: True if this relationship exists only at the type level and has no runtime effect (e.g. TypeScript 'import type').

dynamic.description: True if this relationship was created via a dynamic import (import()) rather than a static import declaration.
